title.zh: DeepSeek把AI编程卷进「许愿时代」：从零造3D游戏，DeepSWE跑分超Opus 5
title.en: DeepSeek把AI编程卷进「许愿时代」：从零造3D游戏，DeepSWE跑分超Opus 5

current_state.zh: DeepSeek upgraded V4.1 Flash to the 1017 version, open-sourced its weights under MIT, claimed a DeepSWE v1.1 software-engineering score above Claude Opus 5, and launched developer-facing Search and Fetch APIs for agent web access.
